name: RefreshPivotOrQuery
label: Refresh PivotTable or Query
description: Refreshes a PivotTable or data query in the workbook.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure Active Directory tenant ID (e.g., 'contoso.onmicrosoft.com' or a GUID).

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Application (Client) ID of the Azure AD registered app used to authenticate with Microsoft Graph.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret (password) of the Azure AD application for service principal authentication.

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library where the Excel file is stored.

fields.name: ItemId
fields.label: Item ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the Excel workbook file within the specified drive.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: PivotTable or Query Name
fields.description: The name of the PivotTable or Power Query (query) in the Excel workbook to refresh.
